history.description: Incremental update workflow, transactional package engine, strict sequence state, tests, and the authoritative 0.19.4 roadmap.
Module schema, configuration, generated registry, classic-script loader, four existing workspace manifests, registry-driven launcher, offline shell integration, tests, and architecture documentation.

Shared application-shell foundation with central design tokens, component primitives, interface-region discovery, panel controller, command registry, compatibility bootstrap, offline caching, tests, and architecture documentation.

Shared visual harmonization for Documents, Spreadsheets, Presentations, and PDF; content-first default panel states; session-only panel preference persistence; and centered PDF open-document empty state.

PDF shell stabilization: deterministic closed-by-default navigation panel, session-only preference, accessible toggle state, zero-width collapsed layout, unified red PDF identity across launcher and viewer, regression tests, and revised ordered roadmap.

PDF selected-text review: highlight, underline, and comment commands derived from PDF.js text-layer selection; multi-line and multi-page page-relative geometry; linked undo groups; free marker/text isolation; persistence compatibility; tests and documentation.
